title: Array Bounds
concept: Protect array and vector access with requires clauses that validate indices before use — preventing buffer overflows and out-of-bounds reads.
why: Out-of-bounds access is one of the most common and dangerous bugs in systems programming. Contracts catch invalid indices at the call site.
tips: Always check BOTH lower (>= 0) and upper (< len()) bounds
For slices, remember end index can equal len() (empty slice) but start cannot
Use @pre in ensures to verify the swap actually happened correctly
common_mistakes: Checking bounds once then using the index N times — check should be in the access function
Using unsigned types to avoid the < 0 check — then you can't represent certain algorithms
